text: Review conclusion: the external proposal is not a file-level defect list. Live code already has strong HRF parity/laws, explicit timing/run-boundary behavior, typed design diagnostics, multiresponse/chunked fit paths, AR censor resets, LSS/GLS/robust coverage, and a public scenario court. Confirmed gaps are narrower: structural design identity was not uniformly carried through model/fit/result values, semantic hypotheses were still name-keyed, and estimability/effective F rank were not retained at the inference seam. The phased plan targets those confirmed gaps while leaving formula-macro, broad HRF redesign, and unsupported statistical features as explicit later decisions.
